title: Same faith is dead/idle apart from love, or living/effective joined to good works
source_text: II. Caeterum fides illa, vel a Dei dilectione, aliisque piis operibus separatim existit, ut contingit in multis peccatoribus; vel cum amore Dei, & aliis bonis operibus juncta est. Priori respectu dicitur mortua atque otiosa, posteriori viva & efficax.
pass_a_gloss: But that faith either exists separately from the love of God and other pious works, as happens in many sinners; or is joined with the love of God and other good works. In the former respect it is called dead and idle, in the latter living and effective.
pass_b_english: Rome distinguishes two states of that same faith: it may stand apart from God's love and other pious works — as in many sinners — or be joined to love and good works.
Apart from love it is called dead and idle; joined to love it is living and effective.

lemmas.gloss: separately from the love of God
